subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
unit: Unit 4: I want to be a doctor!
lesson: Unit 4 – Lesson 6: English in action (talking on the phone)
outcomes: I can ask for a person on the phone.
I can say my name and phone number.
I can take a phone message.

tf.s: We ask: Hello, can I speak to Emily, please?
tf.why: Yes! That is a polite way to ask.

tf.s: When someone isn't there, we say: Emily's not here.
tf.why: Right! Then we ask: Who is this?

tf.s: To say who you are on the phone, we say: I'm is Alice.
We say phone numbers digit by digit.
tf.why: Great! We say each number one by one.

tf.s: We say a phone number as one big number.
tf.why: We say it digit by digit: two-six-nine-zero …

tf.s: A phone message has a name and a phone number.
tf.why: Yes! Write the name and the number.

tf.s: In the dialogue, Manar wants to speak to Nawal.
Nawal answers the phone and talks to Manar.
tf.why: Nawal's not here. She can call Manar later.

tf.s: We end with: Thanks, Manar. Nawal can call you later.
tf.why: Yes! That is a nice way to finish.

tf.s: We say: Emily can calls you later.

boxes.q: How do you ask for a person on the phone?
o: Can I speak to Emily, please?
boxes.why: We say: Can I speak to …, please?

boxes.q: What do you ask when you don't know the caller?
What is the first line of a phone call?
What do you write in a phone message?
boxes.why: A message has the name and the number.

boxes.q: What is the last line of the call?
o: Thanks, Ahmed. Osamah can call you later.
Hello, can I speak to Osamah?

mcq.q: What does Manar say after Who is this?
Which word do we use to be polite?
Which word means 'not now, after some time'?

mcq.why: Write the caller's name and number correctly.

mcq.q: You are Basim (16543408). What do you say?
o: This is Basim. My phone number is 16543408.
Who is Basim? My phone is 16543408.
This is Basim. My phone number is 16543480.
mcq.why: Say This is … and the correct number.

mcq.q: Put in order: A Thanks, Ahmed … / B Hello, can I speak … / C This is Ahmed … / D Osamah's not here …
mcq.why: Hello, then not here, then This is, then Thanks.

mcq.q: Why do we write down the phone number in a message?
o: So the person can call back later
mcq.why: The number helps Nawal call back.

mcq.q: A caller asks for your sister, but she isn't at home. What is the best reply?
o: She's not here. Who is this?
mcq.why: Say she's not here and ask who is calling.
